name: shopsense_retrieval_qa
description: Retrieval-only questions: each is tied to the chunk(s) that answer it by `answer_contains` (a policy code or distinctive phrase), so gold labels cannot drift from however the corpus is chunked. Resolved identically against the markdown and PDF corpora.
